colors_measured.orphan_byte: RED text + pink band, identical to changed bytes (L-only 30 31 32 33 measured red)
colors_measured.empty_slot_hatch: diagonal hatch light gray (230,230,230) on white for slots where the side has no byte (partial tail row: L row3 = 4 bytes + hatch, R row3 = 2 bytes + hatch)
colors_measured.caret: CYAN block (0,255,255) at the current byte - measured sitting on the ASCII-zone cell (row0 char0 both panes)
